items.title: Run Qwen 3.8 Flash Next (125B) on consumer hardware (RTX 4090) at 100T/s
items.title_zh: Strata 在单张 RTX 4090 上运行 Qwen 3.8 Flash Next（125B）
items.title_en: Strata Runs Qwen 3.8 Flash Next (125B) on a Single RTX 4090
items.summary: A Hacker News discussion about running Qwen 3.8 Flash Next (125B) on an RTX 4090 at high throughput using the Strata inference stack, with community benchmarks and quality concerns.

items.title: Why don't more developers “use the platform”?
items.title_zh: Nolan Lawson 追问：开发者为何不愿“使用平台”原生 API
items.title_en: Nolan Lawson asks why developers avoid native web platform APIs
items.summary: Nolan Lawson examines why developers often prefer frameworks like React over native web platform APIs, sparking a detailed HN debate about Web Components, browser inconsistencies, and the practical trade-offs of 'using the platform.'

items.title: Top ARC-ΑGI-3 scores on Kaggle just went from 7% to 56% [N]
items.title_zh: ARC-AGI-3 在 Kaggle 上的最高分 30 天内从 7% 跃升至 56%
items.title_en: ARC-AGI-3 Kaggle scores jump from 7% to 56% in 30 days
items.summary: Kaggle leaderboard scores on the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark reportedly rose from 7% to 56% in 30 days using small local models in a harness, surpassing average human performance on a benchmark designed to show human superiority.

items.title_zh: SK电讯就大规模数据泄露致歉，为全体用户免费更换USIM卡
items.title_en: SK Telecom Apologizes for Massive Data Breach, Offers Free USIM Replacements
items.summary: SK Telecom confirmed a massive hacker breach of its internal HSS servers exposing sensitive data for over 25 million users, prompting a public apology and free USIM card replacements.
